name: Your Name
summary: Two or three sentences: who you are, what you build, what you want next.
experience: Role, Company, dates: one line with your strongest measurable result.
projects: Project name: what it is, one concrete measured result, link if public.
skills_defensible: Only skills you can defend in an interview.
hard_rules: Never claim experience, skills, numbers or results that are not stated in this profile.
Tone: direct, specific, humble, no hype.

form_defaults.NOTE: Anything left empty is treated as NEEDS_USER: the filler leaves it blank and lists it instead of guessing.

preferences.high_stakes_policy: Prestigious fellowships, residencies, pre-docs and frontier-lab roles are tracked and prepared but never auto-applied.
